Lean core already has a command keyword and syntax kind named reprove (reprove thm by tac). Naming the pairing syntax node (name := reprove) failed to parse; the node kind is reproveAs and the surface syntax 'reprove X as Y := t' coexists with the core command. The plan's 'expands to def Y : type_of% @X := t' was replaced by direct elaboration against the type of X with errToSorry off, because a def with an elaboration error is still added with a sorry body and would then have been paired.
